newsitem.title: USA: U.S. mortgage-backeds mixed ahead of FOMC meeting.
newsitem.headline: U.S. mortgage-backeds mixed ahead of FOMC meeting.

text.p: U.S. mortgage-backeds were mixed and spreads to Treasuries tightened in late-afternoon trade ahead of the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting on July 1-2, mortgage experts said.
Trading was relatively active for a summer Monday as market players moved up and down coupons, searching for the ideal portfolio position, one trader said.
"It just seems like a market that is fairly certain what the (Federal Reserve) is going to do, but has no idea what to do in portfolios," he said.

"Breaking out of that trading range would really require a (downward) move on the 10-year (Treasury) yield to about the 6.25-percent level," said Art Frank, vice president of mortgage research at HSBC Securities Inc.

Treasury yields rose Monday as prices slumped after the National Association of Purchasing Management (NAPM) released indices showing economic activity in Cincinnati and New York improved significantly in June.
By late afternoon, Ginnie Mae 30-year 7.5 percent coupons were off 2/32 at 100-14/32 bid, yielding 98 basis points over the 10-year Treasury note.
